Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. We'd like to set up a technical deep-dive / architecture review with our infra and platform folks to validate latency and security assumptions before we move forward with the pilot. Our team would like to cover:

Who from your side would be best to walk through the runtime architecture and perf story? We have availability next week (Mar 14-16) in the morning PT. Can you propose 2-3 slots? Also please send any agenda/docs we can share with our CTO.
